name: Tower of Asher
description: A vast stone tower built on a major Fissure 17 years ago by Asher, a man of faith. His son Edric has corrupted his vision, turning pilgrims into Zealots and sacred halls into ritual chambers. The deeper you climb, the more you understand: someone is digging beneath, and Edric himself is being manipulated.
description_fr: Une vaste tour de pierre erigee il y a 17 ans par Asher, un homme de foi, sur une Fissure majeure. Son fils Edric a corrompu sa vision : les pèlerins sont devenus des Zélotes, les salles sacrées des chambres de rituel. Plus tu montes, plus tu comprends : quelqu'un creuse en dessous, et Edric lui-même est manipule.
description_en: A vast stone tower built on a major Fissure 17 years ago by Asher, a man of faith. His son Edric has corrupted his vision, turning pilgrims into Zealots and sacred halls into ritual chambers. The deeper you climb, the more you understand: someone is digging beneath, and Edric himself is being manipulated.
lore_context: Acte 1 climax. Donjon final raconte l'histoire complete de la Tour. Mode histoire (easy) accessible sans cle pour valider la quete principale. Difficultes superieures necessitent une cle dropee par le boss du palier inferieur.

easy.description: Mode histoire. Difficulte reduite, dialogues actifs, pas de cle requise. Permet de valider q_main_tower_dungeon.

normal.description: Difficulte standard. Cle dropee en mode easy.

floors.name: The Vestibule
floors.description: The hall is still clean. Wall inscriptions tell the founding of the Tower : 'Built by Asher, son of Karim, in year 3 of the Fissure. So that the peoples may lift their eyes.' Acolytes patrol in silence.
floors.description_fr: Le hall est encore propre. Des inscriptions sur les murs racontent la fondation de la Tour : 'Construite par Asher, fils de Karim, en l'an 3 de la Fissure. Pour que les peuples puissent lever les yeux.' Des acolytes patrouillent en silence.
floors.description_en: The hall is still clean. Wall inscriptions tell the founding of the Tower : 'Built by Asher, son of Karim, in year 3 of the Fissure. So that the peoples may lift their eyes.' Acolytes patrol in silence.
floors.story_dialogue: Note au sol : 'Tout homme qui entre ici vient chercher la lumiere. Qu'il la trouve ou non, qu'il reparte en paix.'

floors.name: Hall of Pilgrims
floors.description: Prayer benches, extinguished candles, dusty offerings. This room welcomed pilgrims. Names carved on the walls : people who came to pray here.
floors.description_fr: Des bancs de prière, des bougies eteintes, des offrandes poussiereuses. Cette salle accueillait les pèlerins. Sur les murs, des noms gravés : des gens qui sont venus prier ici.
floors.description_en: Prayer benches, extinguished candles, dusty offerings. This room welcomed pilgrims. Names carved on the walls : people who came to pray here.
floors.story_dialogue: Souvenir d'une vieille femme en priere : 'Asher m'a guerie avec ses mots. Je reviens chaque annee. Mais les dernieres prieres ont change.'

floors.name: The Broken Stairway
floors.description: The stairway is cracked. Ritual marks begin to appear on the walls. This is no longer prayer writing, it is something else. Symbols traced in haste, as if by someone in a hurry, or possessed.
floors.description_fr: L'escalier est fissure. Des marques de rituels commencent a apparaitre sur les murs. Ce n'est plus de l'ecriture de prière. C'est autre chose. Des symboles traces a la hâte, comme par quelqu'un de presse, ou de possede.
floors.description_en: The stairway is cracked. Ritual marks begin to appear on the walls. This is no longer prayer writing, it is something else. Symbols traced in haste, as if by someone in a hurry, or possessed.
floors.story_dialogue: Note au sol : 'Le pere priait. Le fils ordonne.'

floors.name: The Profane Temple
floors.description: The air is heavy. Ritual circles drawn in dried blood cover the floor. Sacred objects have been turned, repurposed. What was a place of prayer has become a place of command. Edric's chosen guards stand watch.
floors.description_fr: L'air est lourd. Des cercles de rituels traces au sol avec du sang sèche. Des objets sacrés ont été retournes, detournes. Ce qui était un lieu de prière est devenu un lieu de commandement. Les gardes d'élite d'Edric montent la garde.
floors.description_en: The air is heavy. Ritual circles drawn in dried blood cover the floor. Sacred objects have been turned, repurposed. What was a place of prayer has become a place of command. Edric's chosen guards stand watch.
floors.story_dialogue: Note murale : 'Le Createur nous a abandonnes. Nous Lui montrerons ce que Ses enfants sont capables de faire sans Lui.'

floors.name: Sevik's Chamber
floors.description: No combat here. Sevik is curled on the floor, exhausted. He was Asher's advisor. He thought the voices were ancient wisdom. He understood too late.
floors.description_fr: Pas de combat ici. Sevik est recroqueville au sol, epuise. Il était le conseiller d'Asher. Il croyait entendre la sagesse des anciens. Il a compris trop tard.
floors.description_en: No combat here. Sevik is curled on the floor, exhausted. He was Asher's advisor. He thought the voices were ancient wisdom. He understood too late.
floors.story_dialogue: Sevik : 'Tu es venu, bien. Il faut que quelqu'un sache. Les voix m'ont dit de creuser. Elles m'ont dit que les fondations du ciel etaient en bas. J'ai cru a de la sagesse ancienne. Maintenant je les entends tout le temps. Elles rient. Elles n'ont jamais voulu qu'on atteigne le ciel. Elles voulaient qu'on creuse. Qu'on ouvre. Edric ne sait pas. Il croit que c'est sa volonte. Mais quelqu'un lui souffle ses pensees. Comme a moi. Sauf que moi, j'ai compris trop tard.'

floors.name: Edric's Throne
floors.description: The deepest chamber, at the top of the Tower. Edric sits on his throne, surrounded by his last guards. He is convinced of his cause. He does not know.
floors.description_fr: La chambre la plus haute, au sommet de la Tour. Edric trône, entoure de ses derniers gardes. Il est convaincu de sa cause. Il ne sait pas.
floors.description_en: The deepest chamber, at the top of the Tower. Edric sits on his throne, surrounded by his last guards. He is convinced of his cause. He does not know.

boss.name: Edric, Heir of the Tower

phases.name: Conviction
phases.description: Edric believes in his cause. He fights with the cold rage of a man who has never doubted.
phases.description_fr: Edric croit en sa cause. Il combat avec la rage froide d'un homme qui n'a jamais doute.
phases.description_en: Edric believes in his cause. He fights with the cold rage of a man who has never doubted.

phases.name: Doubt
phases.description: He hesitates. His attacks slow. Sevik's words echo in his head. He calls his last loyal guards.
phases.description_fr: Il hésite. Ses coups ralentissent. Les mots de Sevik resonnent dans sa tête. Il appelle ses derniers gardes loyaux.
phases.description_en: He hesitates. His attacks slow. Sevik's words echo in his head. He calls his last loyal guards.
mechanics: skill_edric_confused_strike: Random AoE hit, less accurate (CD 12s)

phases.name: Brokenness
phases.description: He understands. He was manipulated, like Sevik. His will collapses. He still fights, but for nothing now. Vulnerable but unpredictable.
phases.description_fr: Il comprend. Il a été manipule, comme Sevik. Sa volonté s'effondre. Il continue de combattre, mais pour rien désormais. Vulnérable mais imprévisible.
phases.description_en: He understands. He was manipulated, like Sevik. His will collapses. He still fights, but for nothing now. Vulnerable but unpredictable.
mechanics: skill_edric_last_word: Self-cast, gains 25% lifesteal for 8s, can be interrupted (CD 20s)
Erratic targeting : 30% chance to attack random target instead of threat

passives: passive_chosen_alpha: All Zealot allies in dungeon gain +20% HP/ATK while Edric is alive
passive_iron_will_phase1: Damage reduction 20% during Phase 1 only (lost in Phase 2)
passive_fissure_taint: Gains +5% ATK per ally killed (max 40%, lore tie to Fissure influence)
boss.post_combat_dialogue: Edric, a genoux : 'Comment... J'avais la force de la Fissure...' Long silence. 'Sevik... les voix... Non. Non, c'etait ma decision. C'etait MON choix.' Plus long silence. 'C'etait pas mon choix, hein ? Quelqu'un me soufflait tout ca. Depuis le debut.' 'Mon pere construisait par amour. Moi j'ai construit par rage. Et la rage n'etait meme pas la mienne.'

achievements.description: Complete Tower of Asher in story mode (talked to Sevik)
achievements.description_fr: Terminer la Tour d'Asher en mode histoire (avoir parle a Sevik)
achievements.description_en: Complete Tower of Asher in story mode (talked to Sevik)

first_clear_bonus._comment_narrative: Le first clear declenche la cinematique de la Fracture (q_main_fracture) : Tour s'effondre, Souffle s'eveille chez le joueur, subclass unlock, transition Acte 2.
